title: DNA From Genealogy Site Cracks Open Murder Case of a Schoolteacher | Cold Case Files | A&E
speaker: A&E
zh: 【A&E】家譜網站的 DNA 破解了一名教師的謀殺案懸案檔案 |急診室（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: NARRATOR: On a chilly morning four days before Christmas, the halls of a Lancaster elementary school
cues.en: NARRATOR: On a chilly morning four days before Christmas, the halls of a Lancaster elementary school
cues.zh: 旁白：聖誕節前四天的一個寒冷的早晨，蘭開斯特小學的禮堂裡

cues.text: buzz with holiday excitement.
cues.en: buzz with holiday excitement.
cues.zh: 充滿節日的興奮。

cues.text: But something is wrong, 6th grade teacher, 25-year-old Christy Mirack is missing.
cues.en: But something is wrong, 6th grade teacher, 25-year-old Christy Mirack is missing.
cues.zh: 但有些不對勁，25 歲​​的六年級老師克里斯蒂·米拉克失蹤了。

cues.text: HARRY GOODMAN: Christy was never late for school.
cues.en: HARRY GOODMAN: Christy was never late for school.
cues.zh: 哈利·古德曼：克里斯蒂上學從來沒有遲到過。

cues.text: I thought, what?
cues.en: I thought, what?
cues.zh: 我想，什麼？

cues.text: You know, it was just so unlike her.
cues.en: You know, it was just so unlike her.
cues.zh: 你知道，這和她太不一樣了。

cues.text: So I called her apartment about five times, nothing.
cues.en: So I called her apartment about five times, nothing.
cues.zh: 所以我給她的公寓打了大約五次電話，但沒有任何結果。

cues.text: I left messages, Christy, where are you?
cues.en: I left messages, Christy, where are you?
cues.zh: 我留言了，克里斯蒂，你在哪裡？

cues.text: We're worried about you.
cues.en: We're worried about you.
cues.zh: 我們很擔心你。

cues.text: And that's when I called her mother.
cues.en: And that's when I called her mother.
cues.zh: 就在那時我打電話給她媽媽。

cues.text: VINCE MIRACK: My mom was kind of in a panic saying, you know, Christy didn't show up for work today,
cues.en: VINCE MIRACK: My mom was kind of in a panic saying, you know, Christy didn't show up for work today,
cues.zh: 文斯·米拉克：我媽媽有點驚慌地說，你知道，克里斯蒂今天沒有來上班，

cues.text: which was really odd.
cues.en: which was really odd.
cues.zh: 這真的很奇怪。

cues.text: We didn't know what to do.
cues.en: We didn't know what to do.
cues.zh: 我們不知道該怎麼辦。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Christy's family lives two hours away.
cues.en: NARRATOR: Christy's family lives two hours away.
cues.zh: 旁白：克里斯蒂的家人住在兩小時車程之外。

cues.text: Principal Harry Goodman volunteers to check on her himself.
cues.en: Principal Harry Goodman volunteers to check on her himself.
cues.zh: 校長哈里·古德曼自願親自檢查她。

cues.text: HARRY GOODMAN: So I pull up to her apartment and her car is iced over.
cues.en: HARRY GOODMAN: So I pull up to her apartment and her car is iced over.
cues.zh: 哈里·古德曼：我把車停到她的公寓，發現她的車結冰了。

cues.text: And I knew something was wrong.
cues.en: And I knew something was wrong.
cues.zh: 我知道出了什麼問題。

cues.text: VINCE MIRACK: Christy was my middle sister.
cues.en: VINCE MIRACK: Christy was my middle sister.
cues.zh: 文斯·米拉克：克里斯蒂是我的二姐。

cues.text: Christy was the kind of person that she always was smiling, always energetic.
cues.en: Christy was the kind of person that she always was smiling, always energetic.
cues.zh: 克里斯蒂是那種總是面帶微笑、總是充滿活力的人。

cues.text: She was that kind of person who also, you know, just kind of trying to make everybody laugh.
cues.en: She was that kind of person who also, you know, just kind of trying to make everybody laugh.
cues.zh: 你知道，她是那種想讓每個人都笑的人。

cues.text: This was Christy and I at our senior prom in May of 1985.
cues.en: This was Christy and I at our senior prom in May of 1985.
cues.zh: 這是 1985 年 5 月克里斯蒂和我在畢業舞會上的情景。

cues.text: She was a very kind person.
cues.en: She was a very kind person.
cues.zh: 她是一個非常善良的人。

cues.text: She was the kind of person that would really do anything for you.
cues.en: She was the kind of person that would really do anything for you.
cues.zh: 她是那種真正願意為你做任何事的人。

cues.text: And I know a lot of people say that, but she truly was.
cues.en: And I know a lot of people say that, but she truly was.
cues.zh: 我知道很多人都這麼說，但她確實是這樣。

cues.text: HARRY GOODMAN: I ran outside the door and slammed it shut.
cues.en: HARRY GOODMAN: I ran outside the door and slammed it shut.
cues.zh: 哈里·古德曼：我跑到門外，把門砰地關上。

cues.text: And I was in shock.
cues.en: And I was in shock.
cues.zh: 我很震驚。

cues.text: I remember I was staggering, going from apartment
cues.en: I remember I was staggering, going from apartment
cues.zh: 我記得我從公寓出來時搖搖晃晃

cues.text: to apartment, pounding on the door, just screaming,
cues.en: to apartment, pounding on the door, just screaming,
cues.zh: 到公寓，敲門，只是尖叫，

cues.text: and finally somebody let me inside.
cues.en: and finally somebody let me inside.
cues.zh: 終於有人讓我進去了。

cues.text: And I called 911.
cues.en: And I called 911.
cues.zh: 我撥打了 911。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Within minutes of Harry's frantic 911 call, police and rescue units arrive at Christy's apartment.
cues.en: NARRATOR: Within minutes of Harry's frantic 911 call, police and rescue units arrive at Christy's apartment.
cues.zh: 旁白：哈利瘋狂地撥打 911 後幾分鐘內，警察和救援部隊就到達了克里斯蒂的公寓。

cues.text: CHRIS ERB: When the officers entered, they did see the body of a young woman
cues.en: CHRIS ERB: When the officers entered, they did see the body of a young woman
cues.zh: 克里斯·埃爾布：當警察進入時，他們確實看到了一名年輕女子的屍體

cues.text: to their immediate left in the living room.
cues.en: to their immediate left in the living room.
cues.zh: 在他們左邊的客廳。

cues.text: She had some significant facial injuries.
cues.en: She had some significant facial injuries.
cues.zh: 她的臉部受了一些嚴重的傷。

cues.text: There were marks around her neck so potentially, a strangulation was involved.
cues.en: There were marks around her neck so potentially, a strangulation was involved.
cues.zh: 她的脖子上有傷痕，很可能是被勒死的。

cues.text: She's nude from the waist down with the exception of her socks.
cues.en: She's nude from the waist down with the exception of her socks.
cues.zh: 她除了襪子外，腰部以下全裸。

cues.text: And her clothing that she had from the waist up
cues.en: And her clothing that she had from the waist up
cues.zh: 還有她腰部以上的衣服

cues.text: were pushed up to her upper chest.
cues.en: were pushed up to her upper chest.
cues.zh: 被推到她的上胸部。

cues.text: Any detective would have a logical conclusion that there's
cues.en: Any detective would have a logical conclusion that there's
cues.zh: 任何偵探都會得出一個合乎邏輯的結論：

cues.text: a sexual assault involved here.
cues.en: a sexual assault involved here.
cues.zh: 這裡涉及性侵犯。

cues.text: It was immediately apparent that there was a struggle that
cues.en: It was immediately apparent that there was a struggle that
cues.zh: 很明顯，有一場鬥爭

cues.text: ensued right inside the door as evidenced by the scuff marks
cues.en: ensued right inside the door as evidenced by the scuff marks
cues.zh: 就在門內，磨損痕跡證明瞭這一點

cues.text: both on the floor, on the frame of the door, on the door.
cues.en: both on the floor, on the frame of the door, on the door.
cues.zh: 都在地板上、門框、門上。

cues.text: The struggle continued into the living room.
cues.en: The struggle continued into the living room.
cues.zh: 鬥爭一直持續到客廳。

cues.text: There was bodily fluid on the carpet so they cut the carpet out around that stain,
cues.en: There was bodily fluid on the carpet so they cut the carpet out around that stain,
cues.zh: 地毯上有體液，所以他們把汙漬周圍的地毯剪掉了，

cues.text: and it was eventually sent to the lab for processing and analysis.
cues.en: and it was eventually sent to the lab for processing and analysis.
cues.zh: 最後被送往實驗室進行處理和分析。

cues.text: NARRATOR: Police begin canvassing the neighborhood.
cues.en: NARRATOR: Police begin canvassing the neighborhood.
cues.zh: 旁白：警方開始在附近地區進行調查。

cues.text: CHRIS ERB: A woman who lived in the same complex said that right around 7:15 that morning,
cues.en: CHRIS ERB: A woman who lived in the same complex said that right around 7:15 that morning,
cues.zh: CHRIS ERB：住在同一棟大樓裡的一位女士說，那天早上 7 點 15 分左右，

cues.text: she was walking her dog.
cues.en: she was walking her dog.
cues.zh: 她正在遛狗。

cues.text: She saw a light-colored or a white-colored vehicle parked in the overflow parking lot which
cues.en: She saw a light-colored or a white-colored vehicle parked in the overflow parking lot which
cues.zh: 她看到一輛淺色或白色的車輛停在溢位的停車場，

cues.text: is directly across the street from Christy's townhouse.
cues.en: is directly across the street from Christy's townhouse.
cues.zh: 就在克里斯蒂聯排別墅的街道對面。

cues.text: She saw what she described as a white male with a muscular type
cues.en: She saw what she described as a white male with a muscular type
cues.zh: 她看到了她所描述的肌肉發達的白人男性

cues.text: build, stringy dark hair exit that vehicle and walk into the area of Christy's apartment
cues.en: build, stringy dark hair exit that vehicle and walk into the area of Christy's apartment
cues.zh: 建立，拉絲黑髮離開那輛車，走進克里斯蒂的公寓區域

cues.text: across the street.
cues.en: across the street.
cues.zh: 街對面。

cues.text: As she was observing all this, her roommate came out.
cues.en: As she was observing all this, her roommate came out.
cues.zh: 正當她注視著這一切的時候，她的室友走了出來。

cues.text: And as they were engaging in conversation, they heard this really loud kind of high-pitched scream.
cues.en: And as they were engaging in conversation, they heard this really loud kind of high-pitched scream.
cues.zh: 當他們正在交談時，他們聽到了這種非常響亮的高亢尖叫聲。

cues.text: They weren't sure if it was Christy or not, but it came from the direction of her apartment.
cues.en: They weren't sure if it was Christy or not, but it came from the direction of her apartment.
cues.zh: 他們不確定是不是克里斯蒂，但聲音是從她公寓的方向傳來的。

cues.text: So the detectives developed a sketch of the person that was
cues.en: So the detectives developed a sketch of the person that was
cues.zh: 所以偵探們畫出了這個人的草圖

cues.text: seen in the area that morning.
cues.en: seen in the area that morning.
cues.zh: 那天早上在該地區看到的。

cues.text: CHRISTINE WILSON: Christy usually left for work around 7:30 to 7:45 in the morning.
cues.en: CHRISTINE WILSON: Christy usually left for work around 7:30 to 7:45 in the morning.
cues.zh: 克里斯汀威爾森：克里斯蒂通常在早上 7:30 至 7:45 左右出發去上班。

cues.text: This was a murder that occurred in broad daylight.
cues.en: This was a murder that occurred in broad daylight.
cues.zh: 這是一起光天化日之下發生的謀殺案。

cues.text: So this was really a brazen act for somebody to enter into the apartment and leave without being seen.
cues.en: So this was really a brazen act for somebody to enter into the apartment and leave without being seen.
cues.zh: 因此，有人在不被發現的情況下進入公寓並離開，這確實是一種厚顏無恥的行為。

cues.text: So it was very frustrating for detectives at the time.
cues.en: So it was very frustrating for detectives at the time.
cues.zh: 所以對於當時的偵探來說是非常沮喪的。

cues.text: The community was on edge, and they wanted to know who
cues.en: The community was on edge, and they wanted to know who
cues.zh: 社群處於緊張狀態，他們想知道誰

cues.text: had committed this heinous act.
cues.en: had committed this heinous act.
cues.zh: 犯下了這種令人髮指的罪。

cues.text: CHRIS ERB: As the investigation moved forward, there were at least 500 people interviewed.
cues.en: CHRIS ERB: As the investigation moved forward, there were at least 500 people interviewed.
cues.zh: CHRIS ERB：隨著調查的推進，至少有 500 人接受了訪談。

cues.text: Detectives, they were interviewing everybody imaginable.
cues.en: Detectives, they were interviewing everybody imaginable.
cues.zh: 偵探們，他們正在採訪所有能想到的人。

cues.text: The detectives also learned about a couple of peeping Tom incidents that occurred right there
cues.en: The detectives also learned about a couple of peeping Tom incidents that occurred right there
cues.zh: 偵探們還瞭解到發生在那裡的幾起偷窺狂事件

cues.text: in Christy's townhouse complex.
cues.en: in Christy's townhouse complex.
cues.zh: 在克里斯蒂的聯排別墅裡。

cues.text: Although the peeping Tom incidents were reported and they were investigated, that led
cues.en: Although the peeping Tom incidents were reported and they were investigated, that led
cues.zh: 儘管偷窺狂事件得到了報導並進行了調查，但這導致了

cues.text: nowhere because the description given was very general.
cues.en: nowhere because the description given was very general.
cues.zh: 無處可去，因為給予的描述非常籠統。

cues.text: They were leaving no stone unturned, trying to find information to build on and move forward.
cues.en: They were leaving no stone unturned, trying to find information to build on and move forward.
cues.zh: 他們不遺餘力地尋找資訊來繼續前進。

cues.text: Just couldn't do it.
cues.en: Just couldn't do it.
cues.zh: 只是做不到。

cues.text: NARRATOR: For the next two years, few leads developed.
cues.en: NARRATOR: For the next two years, few leads developed.
cues.zh: 旁白：在接下來的兩年裡，幾乎沒有發展出線索。

cues.text: The days turned into weeks, and weeks turned into months, and months turned into years.
cues.en: The days turned into weeks, and weeks turned into months, and months turned into years.
cues.zh: 日子變成了幾週，幾週變成了幾個月，幾個月變成了幾年。

cues.text: CHRIS ERB: By 1995, there were at least 1,500 people that
cues.en: CHRIS ERB: By 1995, there were at least 1,500 people that
cues.zh: CHRIS ERB：到 1995 年，至少有 1,500 人

cues.text: were interviewed, nearly 60 people that had been cleared
cues.en: were interviewed, nearly 60 people that had been cleared
cues.zh: 經約談，近60人已清查

cues.text: as suspects in this case.
cues.en: as suspects in this case.
cues.zh: 作為本案的嫌疑犯。

cues.text: CHRISTINE WILSON: And then at this point in time, the case is what investigators would say became cold.
cues.en: CHRISTINE WILSON: And then at this point in time, the case is what investigators would say became cold.
cues.zh: 克里斯汀威爾森：在這個時候，調查人員會說案件已經懸而未決。

cues.text: I knew that the case could always be solved because of the DNA evidence.
cues.en: I knew that the case could always be solved because of the DNA evidence.
cues.zh: 我知道，因為有 DNA 證據，這個案子總是能偵破。

cues.text: And I knew that technology was changing.
cues.en: And I knew that technology was changing.
cues.zh: 我知道科技正在改變。

cues.text: I knew that just getting the additional resources
cues.en: I knew that just getting the additional resources
cues.zh: 我知道只要獲得額外的資源

cues.text: would be able to help to solve the case.
cues.en: would be able to help to solve the case.
cues.zh: 將能夠幫助破案。

cues.text: NARRATOR: A second DNA test of the sample from Christy's apartment is submitted, reigniting the case.
cues.en: NARRATOR: A second DNA test of the sample from Christy's apartment is submitted, reigniting the case.
cues.zh: 旁白：對克里斯蒂公寓樣本進行的第二次 DNA 測試已提交，案件重燃。

cues.text: ANNIE ADAMS: I remember seeing these pictures come out.
cues.en: ANNIE ADAMS: I remember seeing these pictures come out.
cues.zh: 安妮亞當斯：我記得看到這些照片出來了。

cues.text: And I, again, had that fresh hope.
cues.en: And I, again, had that fresh hope.
cues.zh: 我再次有了新的希望。

cues.text: I had that fresh hope that, wow, this is something even further with technology,
cues.en: I had that fresh hope that, wow, this is something even further with technology,
cues.zh: 我有一個新的希望，哇，這是科技帶來的更進一步的東西，

cues.text: and this could be it.
cues.en: and this could be it.
cues.zh: 可能就是這樣。

cues.text: CHRISTINE WILSON: We're hoping that some tips that are going to be generated are going to provide us
cues.en: CHRISTINE WILSON: We're hoping that some tips that are going to be generated are going to provide us
cues.zh: CHRISTINE WILSON：我們希望即將產生的一些提示能為我們提供幫助

cues.text: some useful information in the investigation.
cues.en: some useful information in the investigation.
cues.zh: 調查中一些有用的資訊。

cues.text: Well, that didn't happen.
cues.en: Well, that didn't happen.
cues.zh: 好吧，那並沒有發生。

cues.text: VINCE MIRACK: Things just weren't transpiring the way I thought they were going to.
cues.en: VINCE MIRACK: Things just weren't transpiring the way I thought they were going to.
cues.zh: VINCE MIRACK：事情並沒有按照我想像的方式發展。

cues.text: I got to admit, like I said, it was deflating.
cues.en: I got to admit, like I said, it was deflating.
cues.zh: 我必須承認，就像我說的，它令人洩氣。

cues.text: CHRISTINE WILSON: But we all just persevered, and the goal
cues.en: CHRISTINE WILSON: But we all just persevered, and the goal
cues.zh: 克里斯汀威爾森：但我們都堅持了下來，目標

cues.en: was to never give up here.
cues.zh: 就是在這裡永不放棄。

cues.text: NARRATOR: 25 years after Christy Mirack's murder, there is new hope.
cues.en: NARRATOR: 25 years after Christy Mirack's murder, there is new hope.
cues.zh: 旁白：在克里斯蒂·米拉克被謀殺 25 年後，人們迎來了新的希望。

cues.text: Thanks to the genetic genealogy technology used to capture Joseph DeAngelo, the infamous Golden State
cues.en: Thanks to the genetic genealogy technology used to capture Joseph DeAngelo, the infamous Golden State

cues.text: Killer.
cues.en: Killer.
cues.zh: 殺手。

cues.text: That's when I got started.
cues.en: That's when I got started.
cues.zh: 那是我開始的時候。

cues.en: Thanks to the original crime scene investigators, we had DNA both from Christy herself

cues.en: We were able to upload that to GEDmatch and then wait for the relatives to appear.
cues.zh: 我們能夠將其上傳到 GEDmatch，然後等待親屬出現。

cues.zh: 我知道嫌疑犯有拉丁美洲血統
